title: Due month where the date is sound; Soon for a Low date; no confidence words
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Maintenance Reminders QA build as an Owner/Admin (any user who can open Settings > Maintenance and create and edit work orders and customers).
  2. Make sure 'ZZAUTOTEST Fleet Co' has its Send preventive maintenance notifications setting on, and a contact 'Dave Brabay' with an email address you can read (for example a QA mailbox) set as the preferred contact of unit 'ZZAUTOTEST 402'.
  3. Unit 'ZZAUTOTEST 402' is enrolled with a Calendar service 'PM-C' due in about two months (for example last done 6 Dec 2025, due Dec 2026).
  4. It also has a mileage-triggered service whose due date on the worklist shows a month with Low confidence beneath it, inside the next 91 days (for example a unit whose last mileage reading is more than six months old). If no such unit exists, mark this case Blocked and report it.
  5. On the QA environment, send only to a mailbox the QA team controls.
custom_steps:
1. Open Customers > Maintenance reminders (the worklist). Read 402's rows: PM-C's month, and the meter row's month with Low confidence.
  2. Press Contact, then Send reminder; read the Reminder table. Press Send and read the email.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • PM-C, a calendar date, shows its due month (for example Dec 2026).
  • The row whose date has Low confidence reads Soon instead of a month.
  • The words Low, Medium, High and confidence appear nowhere in the email.
  • Whether a High or Medium meter estimate shows its month or Soon is an open product question: write down what you see and do not pass or fail the case on it.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10575 (S19, The customer reminder email (sent by hand)); story SV-10568 (S11, Rate, estimate and confidence); Chunk 2 MR (Confluence 897679389) as edited 5 October 2026, S19, S11; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S19-R9: “Each row shows its due month where the date is sound. Where a row's date would be a guess, including every Low confidence date, it reads Soon rather than a month the shop would be held to. The email never shows confidence wording”
  • S11-N1: “In Low, a reminder sent by hand shows Soon rather than a month, per S19-R9. The advisor may prefer to call”

AUTOMATION: HOLD - not yet build-verified on a Maintenance Reminders QA build
